precise_target.chain: The n-card random transposition shuffle of section8.2: at each step choose card labels L_t and R_t independently uniformly in [n], transpose them if different and do nothing if equal.
precise_target.initial_scope: Use the section setup (identity initial deck). Proposition8.6 itself restates no initial-card-marking, rather than an additional arbitrary-initial-law assertion.
precise_target.marking_rule: At t=0 no cards are marked. At time t, mark R_t under the prescribed two conditions: R_t is unmarked, and either L_t is marked or L_t=R_t.
precise_target.equal_draws: The draws L_t=R_t are retained: they are no-op transitions of the deck and can mark an unmarked card.
precise_target.tau: First time every card has been marked.
precise_target.conclusion: This specific tau is a strong stationary time for this chain, in the source definition: P_x{tau=t,X_tau=sigma}=P_x{tau=t} pi(sigma), where pi is uniform on S_n.
precise_target.filtration: The driving-card-choice filtration is allowed by the source definition. No unsupported natural-filtration-only restriction is introduced.
not_the_target: Existence of some strong stationary time
Optimality or a sharp cutoff constant
Every marking rule gives an SST

independent_material_assessment.remaining_author_core: The rule is given in the target, but its validity is not a generic stationary-distribution check. The proof selects the joint marked-card set V_t and occupied-position set U_t and maintains conditional uniformity of the entire marked permutation. It handles moving a marked card into the position of an unmarked card and inserting a newly marked card, then averages over all predecessor states. Keeping card labels and positions jointly conditioned is the nonroutine mechanism.
independent_material_assessment.threshold_reason: This dependent partial-permutation invariant and its transition matching give a specific constructive SST beyond routine qualification-level applications of symmetry or coupon collection. No H3 is inferred from the name Broder or from a one-page proof.
independent_material_assessment.author_core_supply: Full statement, heuristic and complete printed induction on121-122; no target-core external gap identified. The final predecessor sum and the at-most-one-marked base case retain the author compression.
independent_material_assessment.proof_boundary: Source proof ends on122 before Remark8.7. The preceding8.5 coupling tail is not part of8.6;8.9/Cor8.10 are later uncounted moment/convergence support.
independent_material_assessment.literal_notation_notice: Source121 writes R_(t+1) in U_t although V_t denotes card labels and U_t positions. Preserve that exact source wording if transcribed and explain the notation issue editorially; this review does not repair or independently validate the mathematics.
independent_material_assessment.errata: The supplied author errata has no8.6 correction. Exercise6.4 correction remains a separate prior-source notice, not a covert change to this proof.
independent_material_assessment.same_work_counting: One proposition. The heuristic, conditional-uniformity subclaim, Remarks8.7-8.8 and the ordinary8.9/Cor8.10 calculation are context/support, not new H2 problems.

related_exercise_8_10_independent_check.exact_parts: (a) An inverse a-shuffle followed by an inverse b-shuffle has the inverse ab-shuffle law, for positive integers a,b. (b) The forward a-shuffle assigns permutation sigma with r rising sequences probability binom(a+n-r,n)/a^n.
related_exercise_8_10_independent_check.rising_sequence_scope: Use the source consecutive-value rising-sequence convention, not an arbitrary ascent run.
related_exercise_8_10_independent_check.reason: The complete selected solution gives combined digit encoding in(a), and in(b) forces r-1 dividers and distributes the a-r free dividers over n+1 gaps with repetition. This is a full author route, but its residual is ordinary digit coding, combinatorial bijection and stars-and-bars after the actual setup is supplied.
